;0x00000d86;((self.$R=self.$R||{})["server-fn:0"]=[],($R=>$R[0]={question:$R[1]={id:1876515338,program:100,test:2,skill:14,difficulty:2,isLive:!1,multiChoice:!0,updateDate:$R[2]=new Date("2023-08-02T20:25:59.616Z"),createDate:$R[3]=new Date("2023-08-02T20:25:59.616Z"),externalId:null,ibn:"020263-DC",stem:"\x3Cp>A park ranger asked a random sample of visitors how far they hiked during their visit. Based on the responses, the estimated mean was found to be 4.5 miles, with an associated margin of error of 0.5 miles. Which of the following is the best conclusion from these data?\x3C/p>",rationale:"\x3Cp>Choice D is correct. The given estimated mean has an associated margin of error because from sample data, the population mean can&rsquo;t be determined precisely. Rather, from the sample mean, an interval can be determined within which it&rsquo;s plausible that the population&rsquo;s mean is likely to lie. Since the estimated mean is 4.5 miles with an associated margin of error of 0.5 miles, it follows that between \x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"4 point 5 minus 0 point 5 \">\x3C/span> miles and \x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"4 point 5 plus 0 point 5\">\x3C/span> miles, or between 4 and 5 miles, is plausibly the mean distance hiked for all visitors.\x3C/p>\x3Cp>Choices A, B, and C are incorrect. Based on the estimated mean, no determination can be made about the number of miles hiked for all visitors to the park.\x3C/p>\x3Cp>\x3C/p>"},answers:$R[4]=[$R[5]={id:11850,question:1876515338,correct:!1,content:"\x3Cp class=\"choice_paragraph \">It is likely that all visitors hiked between 4 and 5 miles.\x3C/p>\n"},$R[6]={id:11851,question:1876515338,correct:!1,content:"\x3Cp class=\"choice_paragraph \">It is likely that most visitors hiked exactly 4.5 miles.\x3C/p>\n"},$R[7]={id:11852,question:1876515338,correct:!1,content:"\x3Cp class=\"choice_paragraph \">It is not possible that any visitor hiked less than 3 miles.\x3C/p>\n"},$R[8]={id:11853,question:1876515338,correct:!0,content:"\x3Cp class=\"choice_paragraph \">It is plausible that the mean distance hiked for all visitors is between 4 and 5 miles.\x3C/p>\n"}],userData:void 0})($R["server-fn:0"]))
